The '''Scrapheap Point''' was an area in the southern hemisphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. It served as the primary base of [[IsoTech]], a front company owned by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Reom]].
